name: Wave pipeline
description: Builds one ticket: the Builder writes the failing test first, then the code; the Code Reviewer sends it back until it is approved (bounded); the Doc Auditor updates the plan documents and traces the requirements to code and tests, a gap goes to the operator; the Integrator opens one merge request with code and documents.

task.description: The ticket: title, slice, files and acceptance tests. It must name its feature on a line "Feature: <slug>" (the plan is in docs/plans/<slug>/) until issues carry it

nodes.message:
The documentation audit found a gap in this ticket: {{.state.doc_audit.reason}}
Approve to open the merge request anyway, reject to stop the ticket.
